newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Union says 2,000 strike at Highveld Steel.
newsitem.headline: Union says 2,000 strike at Highveld Steel.

text.p: The National Union of Metalworkers of South Africa (Numsa) said on Thursday about 2,000 of its members at Highveld Steel and Vanadium Corp Ltd had gone out on strike.
Numsa said in a statement the workers downed tools after a black artisan assistant was allegedly assaulted by a white supervisor.
Numsa regional chairman Ambrose Mthembu said workers were demanding that the supervisor be sacked.
"They are not going back to work while the supervisor is still there," Mthembu said.
A Higveld spokesman confirmed that industrial action was taking place.
"I know there is a strike on," the spokesman said. He had no further details.
Numsa said the artisan was given the same punishment as the white supervisor after an internal disciplinary hearing. Both men were given a final written warning valid for six months.
Numsa said workers at Highveld associate companies would be approached to show their support.
